posts.title: Unlabeled puzzle design: good decoys are all you need
posts.description: Three in four players put the same wrong label on one chart. A look at the decoy behind it, and what it taught me about making puzzles hard but fair.

posts.title: Unlabeled: a daily data and graphs puzzle
posts.description: I've been interested in puzzle design for awhile, from crosswords to NYT Connections and beyond. One way I'm building an understanding of this niche skill is by publishing my own. It's called Unlabeled and it's inspired by my previous work at Tableau as well as my own experience playing games of this type. You're given a set of four charts, or graphs, and your job is to assign the appropriate axis
